short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Sindhi: the complete Bible, with the Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, and the Spirit's in purple.

You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father. FHB is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking, so the Father's own voice is never lost in the page.

This forthcoming edition is the complete Bible for Sindhi readers — Sindhi-speaking families of Sindh in Pakistan, Sindhi communities in India, and the Sindhi diaspora who still pray in their own language.
He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you.

The Sindhi text of this edition is in preparation. Its glossary — how this translation renders our Father, Abba and Heavenly Father in Sindhi — will be settled with native reviewers first, before any Scripture is translated. Nothing is coined ahead of that work.
Available in hardback and paperback. Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Receive The Father. Hear His Voice. His Heart Is For You.
body: The Sindhi Bible, part of Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB), is a forthcoming color coded Bible for Sindhi readers — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
In FHB the Father's words are in blue. The Son's are in red. The Spirit's are in purple. Everything else is in black. You are never left guessing whose voice you are reading.

Sindhi-speaking families across Sindh, churches in Karachi, Hyderabad and the villages of lower Sindh, Sindhi communities in Gujarat and Maharashtra, and the Sindhi diaspora in the Gulf, the UK and North America — and for anyone giving a Bible to someone they love.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

faq.q: Is the Sindhi edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Sindhi, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Sindhi edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Sindhi edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
